messages:
maria: Quick prelaunch check — ACME SI + EdgeCard joint listing is slated for next Tue. Need SOC report, recent pen-test attestation, questionnaire answers, and all artifacts uploaded to the marketplace bucket by Thu EOD. Who owns redaction + presign?

kai: I can own the security checklist + final SOC verification. Which SOC period do we need (Type II window)? Also pen-test needs to include external network + supply-chain scope.

leo: SI side here — we'll deliver questionnaire answers and pen cert. Can someone confirm the exact S3 path and presign TTL? We need time to stage artifacts and do a redaction pass.

nina: HW partner — will attach firmware attestation pdf and SHA256 manifest. Curious what fields you want redacted from the attestation (serials/device IDs)?

maria: Ownership: kai = security sign-off; leo = SI artifact owner; nina = HW artifact owner; maria = release gate owner. Presign path: s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/acme-edgecard/1769504321/ ; presign TTL = 72h. Use this CLI to upload+presign: 

aws s3 cp ./artifact.pdf s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/acme-edgecard/1769504321/ && aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/acme-edgecard/1769504321/artifact.pdf --expires-in 259200

ops-bot: Reminder: Compliance deadline for marketplace listing set to 1769506400 (Thu 23:59 UTC).

kai: For redaction, redact these fields from attachments: device_serial, tester_pii, internal_ip_ranges. Also require raw scanner output (nmap/nessus) + remediation ticket links. If pen vendor is 3rd-party, include scope statement signed by both parties.

leo: I can run our redaction tool and upload the scrubbed bundle. Command we use: 

redwood-scrub --input ./raw-bundle --rules rules/marketplace.json --output ./scrubbed-bundle --keep-manifest

I'll push scrubbed-bundle to the presign path by Wed 18:00 UTC.

nina: Confirmed — we'll redact serials and provide an unredacted copy to kai directly (secure share) for incident response only. Upload ETA: Wed 09:00 UTC. Firmware hash attached in the bundle.

maria: Great. Two gating items for the announcement: 1) kai sign-off on SOC + pen artifacts, 2) marketing hold release flag cleared after redaction review. If both green, we do canary listing on Friday. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they can meet those deadlines?

kai: :thumbsup: — will review SOC & scanner logs by Thu 12:00 UTC.

leo: :thumbsup: uploading Wed 18:00 UTC.

nina: :thumbsup: uploading Wed 09:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks all — I'll create a short checklist and a 15m sync for Thu 13:00 UTC to triage any last-minute issues. Adding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/checklists/acme-edgecard-preflight (internal)

ops-bot: Thread pinned to #partnerships for visibility by maria.
